## 2. The "hold" / idle-park feature

- Flag: `GNSS:351 static bool g_idle_parked;` — written only by the reader: reset `GNSS:5338`, set after open-in-idle `GNSS:5470`, set on entering park `GNSS:5490`, cleared on wake `GNSS:5498`.
- **fd used: the same single `g_uart_fd`** (`GNSS:353`, assigned once at `GNSS:5450`). There is **no second fd and no second `open()` call in the service** (`grep gnss_open` → definition 1659, call 5449 only).
- "UART hold" is a *policy name*, not a second handle:
  - `GNSS:5475-5477` `syslog(LOG_INFO, "gnss: open %s @ %d%s (" GNSS_MOD_PN ", UART hold)\n", …, g_idle_parked ? " idle" : (cycle ? " (pwr)" : ""));`

  - Policy comment `GNSS:1685-1687`: *"仅读线程退出时 close。运行中 close 会 uart_reset_sem，把 recv.lock 搞坏。USART2 和 NSH 一样保持 open 并继续 poll。"* — i.e. hold = keep the one fd open across VCC cycles; `gnss_fd_release` (`GNSS:1685-1694`) is only reached on `g_gnss_stop` (`GNSS:5433`).

- **Blocking read on the hold fd: impossible.** The fd is `O_NONBLOCK` (`GNSS:1661`), so every `read()` returns immediately; the only blocking wait is `poll(&g_uart_pfd, 1, timeout_ms)` at `GNSS:1957`, with timeout hard-clamped to `(0,1000]` ms → 200 ms default (`GNSS:1888-1896`, caller `GNSS:5639 rc = gnss_read_some(fd, GNSS_RX_BATCH, 200);`). While parked the reader keeps looping: `GNSS:5634-5637` logs `"idle uart read %d errno=%d (USART2 hold)"` and discards whatever arrives (`GNSS:5755-5759 rxi = rxn;`).

Episode starts at `gnss_rt_begin()` `GNSS:1026-1036` (`"gnss: rt begin #%u why=%s"`), ends `"gnss: rt end why=%s total=%u …"` `GNSS:995-1012`. `gnss_rt_begin` is called from `gnss_vcc_recover` (`GNSS:1820`, why = trigger string), `gnss_thread_restart` (`GNSS:6424`, "reader-restart") and implicitly from the first mark.

**Per-step marks and delays (a kick/VCC cycle):**

| Phase | Emit site | Delay spent there |
|---|---|---|
| `vcc-off` | `GNSS:1706` | `gnss_sleep_ms(off_ms)` with `off_ms = CONFIG_BOARD_L96_GNSS_PWR_OFF_MS` (defconfig `2500`; fallback `GNSS:104-106 2500`) |
| `vcc-power-down` | `GNSS:1711` | `sf32lb52_l96_power(true)` then `gnss_sleep_ms(on_ms)`, `on_ms = CONFIG_BOARD_L96_GNSS_PWR_DELAY_MS` (fallback `GNSS:101-103 1000`) |
| `vcc-settle` | `GNSS:1715` | end of `gnss_module_power_cycle` `GNSS:1696-1717` |
| `cfg-flush` | `GNSS:1749` | `gnss_flush_host_rx(fd)` `GNSS:1718-1735` (≤32 non-blocking drains) |
| `cfg-zda` | `GNSS:1751` | `gnss_enable_zda(fd)` `GNSS:1621-1643` (1 write, 11 bytes, no ack wait) |
| `cfg-nav` | `GNSS:1753` | `gnss_configure_nav(fd)` — 7× `gnss_cfg_valset_u1` each waiting up to **250 ms** ACK, plus dynmodel retry, `gnss_cfg_dump_signal` `GNSS:2624` |
| `cfg-done` | `GNSS:1788` | ephem injection may follow (`gnss_eph_run` `GNSS:1782`, internal marks `eph-enter/eph-psram-done/eph-fs-begin/eph-prune/eph-src/eph-open/eph-done` `GNSS:3966-4350`) |
| `uart-open` | `GNSS:5460` | mark right after `gnss_open()`; on spawn path `reader-spawn` `GNSS:6403` |

Wake-from-idle path additionally sleeps `CONFIG_BOARD_L96_GNSS_PWR_DELAY_MS` (`GNSS:5496-5499`).

**UBX config-ACK timeout (`cfg ack`):**
- `gnss_cfg_valset_u1()` `GNSS:2329-2349`: `gnss_drain(fd); gnss_ubx_send(fd, 0x06, 0x8a, …); return gnss_ubx_wait_ack(fd, 0x06, 0x8a, 250);` → budget **250 ms**.
- `gnss_ubx_wait_ack()` `GNSS:2305-2328`: loops until 250 ms elapse, each iteration `gnss_ubx_read_frame(fd, &cls, &id, &plen, 80)` (`GNSS:2316`, 80 ms per frame); `return (id == 0x01) ? 1 : -1;` (`GNSS:2324`) → **1 = ACK, -1 = NAK (`CFG-ACK` id=0x00), 0 = no ACK within 250 ms** (documented `GNSS:2533-2536` and `GNSS:2597-2602`).
- Result line: `"gnss: cfg ack dyn=%d elev=%d cno=%d spd=%d aid=%d pvt=%d sig bds=%d"` `GNSS:2621-2623` (so `… -1` = NAK / unsupported value, `0` = 250 ms timeout).
- Other UBX waits on the same fd: `GNSS:2714` (80 ms, dynmodel retry), `GNSS:2776` (300 ms), `GNSS:3068`/`GNSS:3158` (`GNSS_EPH_ACK_MS 80` `GNSS:178`).
